products.name: Pi 5 Air Case
products.subtitle: A clean home for your next big idea.
products.description: A compact, ventilated enclosure concept that keeps your Raspberry Pi project tidy and its connections within reach. Made for a desktop setup, a small home server, or your next weekend experiment.
products.compatibility: Raspberry Pi 5; confirm board revision and cooler clearance before printing.
products.includes: Printed base and lid. Board, cooling hardware and fasteners are not included.
products.imageAlt: Pi 5 Air Case — Graphite 3D printed product concept

products.name: Loop Cable Organizer
products.subtitle: Your cables, right where you left them.
products.description: Three simple arches give loose charging cables a place to live. A small, sculptural detail for the edge of your desk, your bedside table, or wherever cables tend to disappear.
products.compatibility: Designed around standard charging cables. Confirm cable diameter before ordering.
products.includes: One printed organizer. Cables and adhesive are not included.
products.imageAlt: Loop Cable Organizer — Peach 3D printed product concept

products.name: Scout FPV Frame
products.subtitle: The starting point for your next build.
products.description: An open-frame concept for experimenting with quadcopter layouts and component placement. A practical starting point for bench prototypes and learning projects, with room to adapt mounting points to your hardware.
products.compatibility: Prototype concept only. Motor spacing, loads and flight suitability require engineering validation.
products.includes: Printed frame components. Motors, propellers, electronics and fasteners are not included.
products.imageAlt: Scout FPV Frame — Graphite 3D printed product concept

products.name: Node Project Box
products.subtitle: Give your clever little circuit a home.
products.description: A considered enclosure concept for sensor nodes and microcontroller projects. Internal mounting posts and a removable lid help turn a loose collection of wires into a tidy, approachable object.
products.compatibility: Customizable for ESP32 and similar development boards. Supply your exact board dimensions and port positions.
products.includes: Printed box and lid. Electronics, seals and fasteners are not included. Not weatherproof.
products.imageAlt: Node Project Box — Sage 3D printed product concept

products.name: Articulate Arm Parts
products.subtitle: Build a little movement into your next idea.
products.description: A customizable printed parts concept for a desktop robotic arm: structural links, servo brackets and gripper components. Share your servo model, reach and mounting layout to shape the parts around your project.
products.compatibility: Confirm servo dimensions, shaft interface, fasteners, loads and motion clearance before printing.
products.includes: Printed structural parts only. Servos, motors, electronics and fasteners are not included. Assembly shown as a concept.
products.imageAlt: Articulate Arm Parts — Peach 3D printed product concept

products.name: Botanical Wall Triptych
products.subtitle: A quieter wall, with a little more character.
products.description: Three coordinated geometric botanical panels designed to bring depth and rhythm to a living room, workspace, or hallway. The lightweight printed relief creates soft shadows while keeping installation simple.
products.compatibility: Designed for indoor walls. Confirm your preferred overall size, wall surface, spacing and mounting method before printing.
products.includes: Three printed decorative panels. Wall fixings are selected separately to suit your wall surface.
products.imageAlt: Three charcoal geometric botanical 3D printed wall décor panels in a warm modern room

products.name: Angle Charge Mobile Stand
products.subtitle: Your phone, comfortably in view.
products.description: A compact sculptural stand that holds your phone at a useful viewing angle while guiding its charging cable through the base. Made for video calls, recipes, timers, and an uncluttered desk.
products.compatibility: Fits many standard phones. Confirm phone width, thickness, case depth and charging-port position before ordering.
products.includes: One printed stand. Phone and charging cable are not included.
products.imageAlt: Peach 3D printed charging mobile stand holding a graphite smartphone
